mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_rule_summary (report_id, parse_version, rule_version, identity_status, identity_detail, coverage_status, coverage_evidence_json, outcome_status, archive_blocked, safe_normal_allowed, block_code, created_at) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{parseVersion}, #{ruleVersion}, #{identityStatus}, #{identityDetail}, #{coverageStatus}, #{coverageEvidenceJson}, #{outcomeStatus}, #{archiveBlocked}, #{safeNormalAllowed}, #{blockCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT report_id AS reportId, parse_version AS parseVersion, rule_version AS ruleVersion, identity_status AS identityStatus, identity_detail AS identityDetail, coverage_status AS coverageStatus, coverage_evidence_json AS coverageEvidenceJson, outcome_status AS outcomeStatus, archive_blocked AS archiveBlocked, safe_normal_allowed AS safeNormalAllowed, block_code AS blockCode, created_at AS createdAt FROM report_rule_summary WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND parse_version = #{parseVersion}
